description: Engine §10 accepts `($x.without-elision)` as a string receiver for `.ngrams`.
grammar:
%const $S "ab"
%const $Q ("a" "b")
%const $TAG (A B)
%const $P #A
%const $E "a" ∖ "a"
%rule text $x:unit B %conditions ($x.without-elision).ngrams(1) = "a"
%rule unit A [+Z]
%rule family unit
%rule want A
